name: StochTool
description: Stochastic Oscillator - momentum indicator comparing closing price to price range. %K above 80 = overbought, below 20 = oversold. %K/%D crossovers signal entries.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: %K Period
fields.description: Lookback period for %K. CHOOSE based on sensitivity: 5-9 for fast/aggressive signals, 14 for standard, 21+ for slow/reliable signals on volatile stocks.

fields.label: %D Period (SMA)
fields.description: Smoothing for %D signal line. CHOOSE: 3 for standard responsiveness, 5-7 for smoother crossover signals.

fields.label: Smoothing Factor
fields.description: Additional %K smoothing. CHOOSE based on noise: 1 for raw/fast, 3 for standard, 5+ for very noisy/volatile stocks.
